note: Solomon Islands, read on the Immigration Division's own pages (immigration.gov.sb) on 2026-10-30; its fees are stated in US dollars, so the file's currency is USD. Musicians and bands coming to perform for commercial purposes take the Entertainer Visa (Musician, Commercial): a US$400 visa fee and a US$50 online fee (kept together as US$450), a permitted stay of 60 days (the term kept), valid up to 2 years with multiple entries, on a sponsor's letter, with work rights for entertainment only (read as work for the sponsor); an extension takes a new application, so it isn't marked renewable; applications are made online (either, as the page doesn't say from where). Long-term employment: the Working Resident Visa for one holding a work permit from the Commissioner of Labour, US$450 plus the US$50 online fee (US$500), valid 2 years, extended in the islands by the work permit's terms for US$500, applied for from outside the Solomon Islands only; work as the work permit defines. The Permanent Resident Visa (Resident, Long Term) is for one lawfully resident five consecutive years on other visas (5 kept as the long-term employment visa's years to it): US$1,500 plus US$50 online (US$1,550), valid 5 years and renewable; work rights are 'not automatically granted', assessed on the holder's history, read as none until granted. Where it is applied for isn't stated; it is read as in the islands, since it asks five years there. No decision time is published ('there is no specific timeframe'). Naturalisation's years aren't on the pages read.

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Division, Entertainer Visa – Musician (Commercial)
sources.said: This visa is for musicians or bands visiting the Solomon Islands to perform for commercial purposes such as concerts, gigs, or promotional events. ... Visa fee: $400 USD ... Online fee: $50 USD ... Permitted stay: 60 days ... Valid for: Up to 2 years ... re-application required ... Permitted (entertainment-specific) ... Letter from sponsor.

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Division, Long-Term Employment
sources.said: The Long-Term Employment Visa allows foreign nationals to reside and work in the Solomon Islands for an extended period under a valid work permit. ... Visa fee: $450 USD ... Online fee: $50 USD ... Visa validity: 2 years ... in accordance with work permit terms ... $500 USD ... Permitted (as defined in Work Permit) ... You must apply outside of Solomon Islands. ... there is no specific timeframe

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Division, Permanent Resident Visa – Resident (Long Term)
sources.said: This visa is for individuals who have lawfully resided in the Solomon Islands for at least ... five consecutive years ... on other valid visa types and are now seeking permanent residency. ... Visa fee: $1,500 USD ... Visa validity: 5 years ... Yes – renewable after 5 years ... Not automatically granted – assessed based on visa history and compliance
